name: round-up-toggle
title: Round up toggle
description: Offer to round the order up to the next euro for a good cause: the exact extra amount and the cause are in the question, and the switch starts off.
docs: total and step are in minor units: 2457 with a step of 100 offers to round up by 43 to 2500. It is off until the shopper turns it on, so it never nudges; defaultChecked is for restoring their own earlier choice. onChange receives the new state and { amount, total }: add amount to the order as a donation while it is on. When the total is already a multiple of the step the component renders nothing, so treat the donation as zero. cause is in the question, always. round-up.ts holds roundUpOf, which runs on the server too, so the order you charge is computed the same way you showed it.
